SELECT l.sample_no AS sampleNo, l.batch_no AS batchNo, l.material_name AS materialName, l.material_code AS materialCode, l.material_spec AS materialSpec, l.quantity, l.unit_id AS unitId, l.sampler_id AS samplerId, l.sampling_time AS samplingTime, l.receiver_id AS receiverId, l.receive_time AS receiveTime, l.storage_location AS storageLocation FROM lm_retention_receive_ledger l WHERE 1=1
AND l.material_id IN
#{materialId}
AND l.batch_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{batchNo}, '%')
AND l.sample_no LIKE CONCAT('%', #{sampleNo}, '%')
AND l.receive_time >= CONCAT(#{receiveStartDate}, ' 00:00:00')
AND l.receive_time <= CONCAT(#{receiveEndDate}, ' 23:59:59')
ORDER BY l.receive_time DESC
